source: ប្រភេទស្មៅដែលដុះក្នុងស្រែ (Types of Weeds Growing in Rice Fields), agrochemical product-training slide deck for the Hai Au Agro brand herbicides 'Hai Au YOYO 300EC' (Pretilachlor 300g/L + Fenclorim 100g/L) and 'Hai Au Alo 200EC' (Cyhalofop-butyl 200g/L); no institutional letterhead, presenter name, or date visible anywhere in the deck
text:
Hai Au YOYO 300EC is a pre-emergent herbicide combining Pretilachlor 300 g/L with the safener Fenclorim 100 g/L, which protects the rice seed/seedling from the herbicide while it still kills germinating weeds. It targets a broad range of weeds as they germinate, including grasses, sedges, and certain broadleaf weeds; stated features are fast weed control, effectiveness against many weed species from a single product, and reliable performance in flooded rice conditions.

Timing: for broadcast (direct-seeded) rice, apply 1-3 days after sowing; for transplanted rice, apply 7-30 days after transplanting. Application rate given: 50-60 ml per 16-liter backpack sprayer, using 2 backpacks per 1,000 m². Mechanism: the product is absorbed by germinating weed shoots and roots as they push through the treated soil layer, killing them before or just as they emerge, while the Fenclorim safener lets the rice seed germinate normally. Applying with only a thin standing-water layer (not deep flooding) is emphasized for even herbicide distribution across the field.
